description: Implement secure password validation with strong password rules (min 8 chars, mixed case, numbers, special chars) and Have I Been Pwned API check to block commonly compromised passwords. Configure Password::defaults() in AppServiceProvider and create PasswordSecurityService for HIBP integration.
steps: Add 'illuminate/support' Password::defaults() configuration in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php boot() method with rules: min 8 chars, mixedCase, letters, numbers, symbols, uncompromised (Laravel's built-in HIBP check)

Create app/Services/PasswordSecurityService.php with checkHibpBreach() method that calls Have I Been Pwned API v3 (k-anonymity model: hash password with SHA-1, send first 5 chars, check response for full hash match)
Update RegisterController.php to use Password::defaults() validation rule (already in place, just needs AppServiceProvider config)
Create password strength indicator UI component in resources/views/components/password-strength.blade.php showing visual feedback (weak/medium/strong) based on validation rules
Test password validation: attempt registration with weak passwords ('password123', 'qwerty'), compromised passwords from HIBP, and strong unique passwords; verify all validations work and UI updates
acceptance_criteria: Password::defaults() is configured in AppServiceProvider with minimum 8 characters, mixed case, letters, numbers, symbols requirements
Have I Been Pwned API integration blocks passwords found in breaches (using k-anonymity)
Registration form rejects weak passwords with clear error messages
Password strength indicator displays real-time feedback during password entry
Strong unique passwords pass validation and allow successful registration
verification: Run 'php artisan serve' and navigate to http://localhost:8000/register
Test with weak password 'password123' - should be rejected with error message
Test with known breached password 'P@ssw0rd' - should be rejected by HIBP check
Test with strong password 'K3ny@Tutor2026!' - should pass all validations
Verify password strength indicator updates in real-time as user types
Check storage/logs/laravel.log for any HIBP API errors
findings: Password validation successfully configured with Password::defaults() in AppServiceProvider with 8+ char minimum, mixed case, letters, numbers, symbols, and Laravel's built-in uncompromised() check that uses HIBP API. Created PasswordSecurityService with checkHibpBreach() method for manual HIBP integration using k-anonymity model. Added password strength indicator component with real-time visual feedback (weak/medium/strong) integrated into registration form. All acceptance criteria met.
